title: Initial A100 diagnostic candidate pilot
scope_statement: One development instance per size, one optimization seed, and prespecified candidate batches. This is a diagnostic candidate pilot, not a completed tuning exercise, held-out final study, convergence proof, or algorithmic speed comparison.

final_float64.rounded_source: Actual solver-dtype rounded output saved as P_rounded, promoted to float64 without further repair

recomputed_float64_repair.note: Separate numerical audit: reapply rounding to the promoted raw iterate; saved as P_rounded_float64

final_float64.note: CPU float64 evaluation of the saved raw and actual rounded iterates and frozen stored costs; no solver refinement

methodology.seed_derivation: SeedSequence([stochastic_seed, plan_id, oracle_id, batch_size, replicate]); two uint32 words combined and masked to 63 bits. Each evaluation uses a fresh torch.Generator on the selected device.
methodology.timing: perf_counter_ns with CUDA synchronization before sampling and after the complete oracle when using CUDA; interleaved shuffled evaluations after per-configuration warmup. Sampling-inclusive includes RNG draws and oracle, excludes per-evaluation generator setup, diagnostics and file I/O. Kernel timing reuses the just-drawn sample: CPU perf_counter_ns or CUDA stream event elapsed time. CUDA event markers add small instrumentation overhead to inclusive time but no intermediate sampling barrier is inserted. Exact gradient uses identical P and cached A^2/B^2 on same dtype/backend/thread policy.
methodology.variance: sum ||Ghat - sample_mean||_F^2 / (repetitions-1), via Welford; this is an unbiased sample estimator of total Frobenius variance.
methodology.mean_bias: ||sample_mean - G||_F is empirical finite-sample mean error, not evidence of theoretical bias. sqrt(sample_variance/repetitions) records its sampling-noise scale.
methodology.decision_error: <G,row_lmo(Ghat,a)> - sum_i a_i min_j G_ij; argmin uses the first index on ties. Values are not clipped.
methodology.anchor_caveat: Supplied Python-loop reference anchor implementation; timing is not a production implementation speedup comparison.
methodology.independence: Plan permutations, oracle draws and evaluation ordering use separate seed streams. Frozen planted correspondence never enters plan construction or evaluation.
